Topics · Hard times

I am old and alone. Is anyone listening?

Loneliness in old age: a hidden call heard, a God who hears and sees, a nearness that asks no place or hour.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا٣ قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا٤﴾

Translation of the meaning

When he called to his Lord a private call [i.e., supplication]. He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled[807] with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed].

Translator's notes

[807] Literally, "ignited." The spread of white hair throughout the head is likened to that of fire in the bush.

Quran · Maryam 19:3-4

Translation

The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense. An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense. Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him. But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

Original · Ancient Greek

καὶ πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος ἦν τοῦ λαοῦ προσευχόμενον ἔξω τῇ ὥρᾳ τοῦ θυμιάματος· ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἑστὼς ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ θυμιάματος. καὶ ἐταράχθη Ζαχαρίας ἰδών, καὶ φόβος ἐπέπεσεν ἐπʼ αὐτόν. εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ ἄγγελος· Μὴ φοβοῦ, Ζαχαρία, διότι εἰσηκούσθη ἡ δέησίς σου, καὶ ἡ γυνή σου Ἐλισάβετ γεννήσει υἱόν σοι, καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰωάννην·

the Gospel (Luke) · 1:10-13

World English Bible

Old age can be very quiet. This verse gives the voice of a man who had reached it: his bones weak, his head white. It says he called his Lord in a hidden call, not on a stage, not for anyone's ears. And what he says is gentle: calling You has never left me unhappy. A quiet call is a whole call.

A question for you

What would you like to say, if someone were listening?

If you sayI miss them.
ThenMissing is a sign that something good was there. Say it as it is, without dressing it up.
If you sayI am afraid.
ThenFear has a place in the verse itself: the man speaks from his weakness. You are not asked to seem strong.
If you sayNothing. I am only tired.
ThenTiredness is a kind of speaking too. This page asks no more of you than to read it.

Part 2 of 3

﴿قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ﴾

Translation of the meaning

[Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

Quran · Ta-Ha 20:46

Translation

Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

Original · Hebrew

גַּ֤ם כִּֽי־אֵלֵ֨ךְ בְּגֵ֪יא צַלְמָ֡וֶת לֹא־אִ֘ירָ֤א רָ֗ע כִּי־אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּדִ֑י שִׁבְטְךָ֥ וּ֝מִשְׁעַנְתֶּ֗ךָ הֵ֣מָּה יְנַֽחֲמֻֽנִי׃

the Psalms · 23:4

World English Bible

Here God speaks to two people about to face someone frightening: do not be afraid, I am with you both, I hear and I see. Hear and see. Those words were said to two prophets. The next part widens the 'with' to everyone. So the One who hears and sees would take in your room too: the chair, the television, the evening.

A question for you

Which phrase touches you most?

If you sayI hear.
ThenA short word, with no conditions and no special language.
If you sayI see.
ThenTo be seen without judgment is what lonely people miss most.
If you sayI am with you both.
ThenThe 'with' here is given to two people, and the next part gives it to everyone.

﴿هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne.[1627] He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you[1628] wherever you are. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

Translator's notes

[1627] See footnotes to 2:19 and 7:54. [1628] In knowledge - observing and witnessing.

Quran · Al-Hadid 57:4

Translation

There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

Original · Ancient Greek

καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν κτίσις ἀφανὴς ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, πάντα δὲ γυμνὰ καὶ τετραχηλισμένα τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ, πρὸς ὃν ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος.

Hebrews · 4:13

World English Bible

The verse says He is with you wherever you are, and ends by saying He sees what you do. 'Wherever' includes a flat on the fifth floor with the heating low. It includes the phone in your hand. The verse does not say God replaces the voices you miss, only that you are not alone while you wait for them.

A question for you

Whom might you call this week?

If you sayOne of my children.
ThenBegin with something small: what you ate, what you saw. A small sentence is the start of the road.
If you sayA neighbour, or someone I know from my community.
ThenThe neighbour is named in the Quran, near and far. Perhaps they too say a great deal to the television.
If you sayNo one yet. I will begin by talking to Him.
ThenThat is fine. That beginning needs no one but you.

The same in the other books

Translation
